content: MutationObserver hazards: callbacks that write to the DOM re-trigger themselves; guards are attributeFilter to exclude the attribute you write, an idempotency marker so already-processed nodes are skipped, or disconnect()/takeRecords() around the write followed by re-observe. takeRecords() drains the pending queue and is the standard pre-disconnect flush. Observing document.body with subtree+childList+attributes on an SPA fires constantly; scope to the nearest stable container and batch callback work into a single requestAnimationFrame or microtask. Reading layout (offsetHeight/getComputedStyle) then writing in the same loop forces synchronous layout (layout thrashing).
